### Array on Path

Distribute instances along a curve with tangent-aligned orientation

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Collection** | `collection` |  |  | Source collection to distribute along the path. |
| **Spacer Curve** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Curve** | `curve` |  |  | Target curve — pick any BRep edge or sketch curve. |
| **Spacer Dist** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Mode** | `enum` | count | {'count': 'Count', 'spacing': 'Spacing'} | count: fixed number of instances; spacing: fixed arc-length gap (cm). |
| **Value** | `float` | 10 | 0.001 … ∞ | Number of instances (count mode) or arc-length gap in cm (spacing mode). |
| **Spacer Margins** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Margin Start** | `float` (cm) | 0 | 0 … ∞ | Arc-length margin from curve start before first instance (cm). |
| **Margin End** | `float` (cm) | 0 | 0 … ∞ | Arc-length margin from curve end after last instance (cm). |
| **Spacer Orient** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Up** | `vector3` | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 1.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | World-space up hint for frame orientation (Fusion 360 is Y-up by convention). |
| **Align To Tangent** | `boolean` | True |  | Orient instances so local +Z faces along the curve tangent. |
| **Spacer Sizing** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Scale Start** | `float` | 1 | 0.001 … ∞ | XY scale multiplier at the first instance. |
| **Scale End** | `float` | 1 | 0.001 … ∞ | XY scale multiplier at the last instance. |
| **Spacer Rotations** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Twist** | `float` (degrees) | 0 |  | Total twist in degrees distributed evenly across all instances. |
| **Bank Factor** | `float` | 0 |  | Curvature-driven tilt around the tangent axis. Positive = bank into curve, negative = bank away. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Collection** | `collection` | Instances distributed along the path |

### Surface Grid Array

Create world-space walking grid arrays on surfaces

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Collection** | `collection` |  |  | The instances to arrange on the surface. |
| **Spacer 0** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Surface** | `surface` |  |  | Pick the face in Fusion to arrange the instances on. |
| **Spacer 1** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Count U** | `integer` | 5 | 1 … 100 | Number of instances along the surface's U direction. |
| **Count V** | `integer` | 5 | 1 … 100 | Number of instances along the surface's V direction. |
| **Spacing U** | `float` (cm) | 3 | 0.001 … ∞ | Distance between neighboring instances along U. |
| **Spacing V** | `float` (cm) | 3 | 0.001 … ∞ | Distance between neighboring rows along V. |
| **Spacer 2** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Stagger Offset** | `float` | 0 | -0.5 … 0.5 | Shifts every other row by this fraction of a column; negative shifts the other way. |
| **Spacer 3** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Position U** | `float` | 0.5 | 0 … 1 | Where the grid's center sits along U, 0 at one edge and 1 at the other. |
| **Position V** | `float` | 0.5 | 0 … 1 | Where the grid's center sits along V, 0 at one edge and 1 at the other. |
| **Edge Margin** | `float` (cm) | 0 | 0 … ∞ | Distance to keep clear of the surface edges. |
| **Spacer 4** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Rotation** | `float` (degrees) | 0 |  | Turns the grid pattern, and each instance, about the surface normal. |
| **Align To Normal** | `boolean` | True |  | Stand each instance along the surface normal; off keeps its original orientation. |
| **Spacer 5** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **U Bias** | `float` | 0 | 0 … 1 | Blends U placement from even real-world spacing (0) to following the surface's UV flow (1). |
| **V Bias** | `float` | 0 | 0 … 1 | Blends V placement from even real-world spacing (0) to following the surface's UV flow (1). |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Collection** | `collection` |  |

## Effector

### Falloff Effector

Apply spatial falloff effects to collections

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Collection** | `collection` |  |  | The instances to transform. |
| **Transform** | `transform` |  |  | The move, rotate, scale or aim to apply, weighted by the falloff at each instance. |
| **Spacer 1** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Shape** | `enum` | sphere | {'sphere': 'Sphere', 'linear': 'Linear', 'box': 'Box'} | How position becomes strength: distance from a center, progress along a line, or distance from a box. |
| **Center** | `vector3` (cm) | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 0.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | The middle of the sphere or box. |
| **Start** | `vector3` (cm) | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 0.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | Where the line begins; instances at or before it get the curve's start value. |
| **End** | `vector3` (cm) | {'x': 10.0, 'y': 0.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | Where the line ends; instances at or past it get the curve's end value. |
| **Radius** | `float` (cm) | 10 | 0.001 … ∞ | Distance from the center where the fade reaches the curve's end value. |
| **Inner Radius** | `float` (cm) | 0 | 0 … ∞ | Distance from the center where the fade begins; inside it the curve's start value holds. |
| **Scale** | `vector3` | {'x': 1.0, 'y': 1.0, 'z': 1.0} |  | Stretches the field along its local axes. |
| **X Axis** | `vector3` | {'x': 1.0, 'y': 0.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | The field's local X axis; Scale x stretches along it. |
| **Y Axis** | `vector3` | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 1.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | The field's local Y axis, squared up to the X Axis; Scale y stretches along it. |
| **Curve** | `string` | {"degree":3,"points":[[0.0,1.0],[0.2,1.0],[0.65,0.0],[1.0,0.0]],"repeat":1,"repeat_style":"mirror","decay":0.0,"invert":false,"lead":"start","output":{"start":1.0,"end":0.0}} |  | How strength changes across the field; shape it in the curve editor. |
| **Spacer 3** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Strength** | `float` | 1 |  | Multiplies the falloff's strength; negative pushes the other way. Connect a modifier to vary it. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Collection** | `collection` |  |

| **Min** | `float` | 0 |  | The lowest value an instance can receive. |
| **Max** | `float` | 1 |  | The highest value an instance can receive. |
| **Seed** | `integer` | 0 |  | Change it for a different set of values; the same seed always gives the same set. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Value** | `float` |  |

### Wave

Sinusoidal strength pattern along strand position

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Amplitude** | `float` | 1 |  | Height of the wave; strength swings between plus and minus this value. |
| **Frequency** | `float` | 1 | 0 … ∞ | How fast the wave cycles from one instance to the next, in radians per instance. |
| **Phase Offset** | `float` | 0 |  | Shifts the wave along the strand, in radians. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Modifier** | `float` |  |

## Transform

### Aim

Rotate instances so a local axis points toward a world-space position

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Spacer 1** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Position** | `vector3` (cm) | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 0.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | The point each instance turns to face. |
| **Spacer 2** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **Aim Vector** | `vector3` | {'x': 0.0, 'y': 1.0, 'z': 0.0} |  | The instance's own axis that points at the target. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Transform** | `transform` |  |

### Apply Transform

Bake a transform into seed geometry, redefining its origin relationship

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Geometry** | `geometry` |  |  | The body to bake the transform into. |
| **Transform** | `transform` |  |  | The move, rotate, scale or aim to bake in; an aim turns the body about its centre toward the target. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Geometry** | `geometry` |  |

### Move

Create translation transforms with chaining support

| Input | Type | Default | Range / options | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Input Transform** | `transform` |  |  | An earlier transform to build on; this move is applied after it. |
| **Translation Spacer** | `spacer` |  |  |  |
| **X** | `float` (cm) | 0 |  | Distance to move along X. |
| **Y** | `float` (cm) | 0 |  | Distance to move along Y. |
| **Z** | `float` (cm) | 0 |  | Distance to move along Z. |

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **Output Spacer** | `spacer` |  |
| **Transform** | `transform` |  |
